title: Academic Management, Academic Policies and shared student CBT integrity repairs
status: All 13 audited findings repaired and regression verified; deployment requires the updated portal and local CBT server
scope: School academic workflows and the local CBT server/shared client used by browser and Android students. Existing finance changes are preserved.

repairs.change: Omitted/all section requests inherit a restricted actor's assigned section; explicit disallowed sections still fail.

Teacher memberships and related records are period-scoped; score sheets require the allocated subject/classroom or explicit form-teacher/substitute authority. Ordinary teaching allocations do not expose historical transcripts. Intentional class-wide CBT rosters are retained.
Midterm calculations reuse the scorebook's Objective/Theory exemption handling and reweight selected components. Result snapshots preserve part states.
Policy save, activation and inheritance reset use conditional assignment writes. Settings sends the reviewed revision and exact draft ID and blocks activation of unsaved edits.
Attendance always requires membership in the selected classroom, including when its roster is empty.

Single, batch, copy and delete timetable mutations share an atomic draft-version guard read before lesson data. Concurrent changes reject rather than double-book. Targeted copies are atomic and capped at 498 new lessons.
Midterm selection retains the original assessment-component row mapping before filtering checked components.

Removed unsupported scholarship/payment-plan switches and explain the existing clearance rules. Full-scholarship eligibility, billing, payments and legacy stored fields remain unchanged; agreed payment-plan exceptions use approved result clearance.
IndexedDB answer writes and acknowledgement deletes compare revisions transactionally. Replay preserves newer answers, and delayed saves remain bound to their original authenticated attempt.

Submission flushes debounced text, freezes answer controls, waits for persistence/uploads and checks both recovery storage and in-memory unsaved revisions. Unconfirmed answers block manual finalization and show an explicit deadline warning; delayed text events cannot write into another attempt.

Objective and theory submissions persist terminal receipts keyed by hashed session token and bound to device/tab. Retrying after a lost acknowledgement or restart returns the receipt without reopening answer access.

Startup, monitoring, exam-status changes and marking finalize overdue disconnected attempts server-side with confirmed answers intact. Theory expiry is also finalized without creating typed response records.
A lost paper-save acknowledgement is reconciled against the exact persisted record/digest. Uncertain saves retain uploaded files; definite rejected saves may clean them up.

validation.note: Read-only release checks; no release performed.
Includes loopback-server tests. Existing HTTPError cleanup ResourceWarnings and a Tk after-callback warning were emitted; unittest result was OK.
All attempts and answers survived restart and encrypted backup/restore. Synthetic temporary data only; not a multi-device Wi-Fi test.

validation.command: git diff --check and JavaScript syntax checks

deploymentNotes: Portal policy API and Settings assets must be deployed together; old clients without reviewed revision tokens are rejected safely.
The local CBT receipt table is created additively on startup. Existing data is not rewritten by this repair session.
Local CBT startup will finalize overdue attempts once the updated server is run against a school database.
Existing published results are not recalculated automatically; affected midterms require the normal authorized review/recalculation workflow.
Validation used synthetic data only and did not package applications, install APKs or change production records. Pushing the source is separate from desktop packaging and deployment.
remainingValidationLimits: Physical Android camera, orientation, kiosk behaviour, process death and background behaviour remain untested in this repair session.
No real access-point loss, multi-device Wi-Fi load or tablet battery interruption tests were performed.
Firestore/R2 concurrency and uncertain saves were tested with controlled fault injection, not production writes.
Uncertain paper uploads are intentionally retained; this change does not introduce an automatic orphan-deletion job.
